entries.t: 世界最大托卡马克装置将330吨磁体冷却至近绝对零度
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/核电
entries.as: ITER（国际热核聚变实验堆）的磁体冷测试设施已启动，工程师成功将330吨超导磁体冷却至接近绝对零度。该冷却过程历时12天，是托卡马克装置运行前的关键步骤。极低温环境是超导磁体产生强约束磁场的前提条件，此次冷却标志着ITER向高电流试验阶段迈出重要一步，为后续等离子体约束和聚变点火奠定基础。
kp: 磁体质量[ITER环向场线圈]: 330吨
工作温度[ITER超导磁体]: 4 K（-269°C）
entries.b:
Engineers are preparing for high-current trials at ITER’s newly activated Magnet Cold Test Facility, following a 12-day cooling process that lowered a 330-ton toroidal field coil to its functioning temperature of 4 Kelvin (minus 269 degrees Celsius). This operational milestone was celebrated yesterday during a site visit by the ITER Council’s Management Advisory Committee.
This program verifies magnet performance before the parts are locked into the main reactor. Over the course of four to six months per coil, the team will subject components to full operational electrical currents, which reach 68 kiloamperes (kA) for the toroidal field units and 48 kA for the poloidal field units.
“Eighteen D-shaped toroidal field coils, six ring-shaped poloidal field coils, and the six independent modules of the central solenoid-with a combined stored magnetic energy of 51 Gigajoules (GJ)-will produce the magnetic fields that initiate, confine, shape and control the ITER plasma,” said ITER in a press release.
Constructed from niobium-tin (Nb3Sn) and niobium-titanium (Nb-Ti), these alloys require liquid helium immersion to lose their electrical resistance.
Superconducting systems are essential for industrial-scale fusion because they generate
intense magnetic fields
with minimal electricity compared to copper variants. However, this state relies on keeping temperatures, current levels, and magnetic forces below strict physical limits.
If these thresholds fail, the material undergoes a “quench,” reverting to a standard resistive state that releases sudden heat. Consequently, a major goal of these cold runs is verifying that the automatic safety sensors detect these thermal changes instantly.
Running these benches alongside existing plant networks provides early data on how the central control systems, power feeds, vacuums, and cooling setups interact. This parallel testing reveals vulnerabilities prior to final plant commissioning.
Though the setup cannot mimic the exact environment of an active fusion reaction, it measures how the magnets handle stress, monitors insulation behavior, and checks the integrity of internal superconducting joints.
Managing components that weigh hundreds of tonnes demands significant logistics, including a 20-meter-long cryostat chamber, heavy electrical links, and direct lines to the facility’s primary helium cryoplant.
built this testing area inside an assembly hall formerly used by Fusion for Energy for shaping large exterior coils, capitalizing on the building’s existing heavy cranes and its layout.
ITER Director-General Pietro Barabaschi noted that adapting this existing footprint allowed the organization to lower project risks logically before starting full system integration. He added that the facility will eventually serve the broader commercial fusion market by sharing technical insights.
Once ITER finishes its own scheduled runs on the initial niobium-tin (Nb3Sn) coil and subsequent manufacturer deliveries, private fusion ventures will gain access to the testing area.
“This is important for ITER as well as an example of how ITER can support the wider fusion ecosystem by creating knowledge, infrastructure, and operational experience that others can use,”

entries.t: 福建农林欧阳新华等人Nat Commun：打破SAM分子聚集与电荷传输的“跷跷板”，助力钙钛矿/硅叠层电池实现33%认证效率_手机网易网
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/光伏
entries.as: 福建农林大学欧阳新华团队在Nature Communications报道打破SAM分子聚集与电荷传输跷跷板效应的策略。设计合成一系列立体扩展不对称咔唑基自组装单层分子(BABCz、BADBCz、MeO-BADCz)，通过单晶解析和分子动力学模拟揭示分子构型对聚集行为和空穴传输的调控机制，助力钙钛矿/硅叠层电池实现33%认证效率。
kp: SAM分子[钙钛矿/硅叠层]: MeO-BADCz
entries.b:
Tingxia Yan, Chenxu He（共同第一作者）
欧阳新华 & Chi Li
1.设计并合成了一系列立体扩展的不对称咔唑基自组装单层分子（BABCz、BADBCz、MeO-BADCz），通过单晶结构解析和分子动力学模拟，系统揭示了分子构象与堆积模式对聚集行为和电荷传输的影响规律。
2.MeO-BADCz采用三节段扭曲构象，有效抑制长程结晶和过度聚集，同时通过多维度的C–H···π相互作用构建了连续的三维
逾渗网络，解决了传统SAM难以兼顾均匀覆盖与高效传输的矛盾。
3.基于MeO-BADCz的宽带隙（1.68 eV）钙钛矿太阳能电池实现了24.05%的光电转换效率，在ISOS-L-1协议下连续运行1000小时后仍保持97.1%的初始效率。
4将.MeO-BADCz应用于织构化硅异质结底电池的复合层，制备的
获得33.53%的实验室效率，并经第三方认证达到33.04%，同时表现出优异的湿热和光照稳定性。
一、实现高效稳定钙钛矿/硅
太阳能电池存在的问题与挑战，以及本文的核心成果
在钙钛矿/硅叠层太阳能电池中，自组装单层作为空穴选择层和复合结材料，对调控功函数、减少能量损失、支撑高质量钙钛矿生长至关重要。然而，常用的对称型咔唑基SAM（如PACz系列）存在刚性π共轭骨架、有限的锚定功能、弱分子间耦合以及缺乏空间位阻调节等结构缺陷，容易导致分子过度聚集，难以在粗糙的织构化硅衬底上形成均匀、无针孔的分子层，从而造成界面复合严重、
提取效率低下。尽管近年来通过分子不对称设计和引入甲氧基等官能团取得了一定进展，但如何在同一分子中同时抑制过度聚集又保持连续高效的电荷传输通道，仍然缺乏清晰的设计原则。针对这一难题，本文设计并合成了三种立体扩展的不对称咔唑基SAM分子——BABCz、BADBCz和MeO-BADCz，通过
结构解析、分子动力学模拟和多种界面表征，系统揭示了分子构象与堆积模式对聚集行为和电荷传输的影响规律。其中，MeO-BADCz采用三节段扭曲构象，在有效抑制长程结晶和过度聚集的同时，通过多维度的C–H···π相互作用构建了连续的三维电荷逾渗网络，并凭借甲氧基的电子给体效应增强了界面钝化和功函数调控能力。基于MeO-BADCz的宽带隙钙钛矿太阳能电池实现了24.05%的光电转换效率，在ISOS-L-1协议下连续运行1000小时后仍保持97.1%的初始效率。将该SAM应用于织构化硅异质结底电池的复合层，所制备的钙钛矿/硅叠层电池获得了33.53%的实验室效率，并经第三方认证达到33.04%，且表现出优异的湿热和光照稳定性。这项工作为设计适用于粗糙衬底、兼具抗聚集与高效电荷传输的SAM材料提供了明确的理论指导和分子工程策略。
二、结果与讨论 要点1：分子设计、电化学稳定性与聚集行为调控
BABCz、BADBCz和MeO-BADCz通过不对称共轭策略逐步扩展空间位阻，其中MeO-BADCz在3,6-二甲氧基咔唑和苯甲酸之间引入额外的咔唑单元，形成三节段扭曲骨架。循环伏安扫描显示，BABCz和BADBCz随扫描次数增加电流密度显著下降，而MeO-BADCz仅略有变化，表明其具有更优的电化学稳定性。在光热老化（1个太阳，24小时）下，三种合成SAM均优于商业4PACz（后者出现明显变色和杂质峰）。动态光散射显示，BABCz的粒径分布宽（173–380 nm），BADBCz居中（106–208 nm），而MeO-BADCz最窄（36–67 nm），有利于在ITO表面形成均匀分子层。GIWAXS进一步证实，BABCz呈现明显的布拉格斑点（高结晶性），BADBCz中等，MeO-BADCz结晶性最弱，说明空间位阻有效抑制了长程聚集。分子动力学模拟表明，在ITO表面随机放置200个分子后，MeO-BADCz表现出明显的构象自适应性，最终形成更均匀、稳定的表面覆盖，而BABCz和BADBCz则出现不均匀团聚。
要点2：单晶结构揭示堆积模式与电荷传输通道
BABCz的单晶结构显示，BCz核心与苯环之间的二面角达61.85°，分子呈T型堆积，纵向滑移6.674 Å，π–π重叠不足，但通过多个C–H···π相互作用（距离3.049–3.784 Å）维持了一定程度的电荷传输通道。BADBCz的二面角增大至89.82°，滑移距离增至8.580 Å，平行相邻二聚体的C–H···π距离分别为4.062 Å和6.390 Å，超出典型π相互作用范围，聚集显著减弱，但电荷传输路径也被严重削弱。MeO-BADCz呈现三平面扭曲构象（咔唑-苯环二面角68.73°，甲氧基咔唑-苯环二面角60.54°），平行相邻二聚体展示多组C–H···π相互作用（3.202 Å、3.578 Å），纵向滑移8.139 Å。不同二聚体之间像手指交错，形成三维互锁网络。这种结构不仅最有效地抑制了聚集，还构建了连续、高效的电荷逾渗通道。单空穴器件显示MeO-BADCz具有最显著的欧姆行为，验证了其优异的空穴传输能力。
要点3：界面多功能调控——锚定、功函数、钝化与能级匹配
DFT计算吸附能显示，MeO-BADCz在ITO上的吸附能为-3.36 eV，远低于BABCz（-1.79 eV）和BADBCz（-1.74 eV）。XPS中In 3d峰位移更大，AFM-IR显示MeO-BADCz在清洗后仍保持强红外信号，证明其强锚定和界面稳定性；在织构化硅衬底上同样表现出更均匀的红外响应。KPFM测得裸ITO功函数4.72 eV，经BADBCz、BABCz、MeO-BADCz处理后分别升至4.94、5.07、5.12 eV，MeO-BADCz的最大功函数归因于其较大的分子偶极矩（ESP显示甲氧基引入额外负电势区），有利于空穴提取。UPS表明MeO-BADCz与钙钛矿的HOMO/VBM能级偏移最小，减少了界面非辐射复合。接触角测试显示MeO-BADCz具有最佳润湿性（79.8°），钙钛矿薄膜平均晶粒尺寸达382 nm（BABCz 302 nm，BADBCz 286 nm），埋底界面几乎无针孔。XPS中Pb 4f峰向低结合能移动，FTIR显示C–O峰下移5 cm⁻¹，证实甲氧基与铅的相互作用。DFT缺陷形成能计算表明，MeO-BADCz大幅提高了PbI反位、I空位等缺陷的形成能，有效钝化铅相关缺陷。KPFM对埋底界面测量显示，MeO-BADCz表面电位最低（-315 mV），表明更强的p型特性和向上的能带弯曲，促进光生空穴提取并排斥电子。原位时间依赖PL显示，BADBCz样品在85分钟光照后PL峰蓝移6 nm且强度显著下降，BABCz强度下降但峰位稳定，而MeO-BADCz变化最小，证明其有效抑制了宽带隙钙钛矿的光致相偏析。
要点4：单结宽带隙钙钛矿太阳能电池性能
器件结构为ITO/HSL/Perovskite (1.68 eV)/LiF/C60/BCP/Ag。BADBCz器件PCE为21.97%（Voc 1.202 V，Jsc 21.89 mA/cm²，FF 83.48%）；BABCz器件PCE为22.92%；MeO-BADCz器件最佳，反向扫描PCE为24.05%（Voc 1.261 V，Jsc 22.13 mA/cm²，FF 86.18%），正向扫描23.89%，迟滞指数仅0.06%。该效率是宽带隙PSC的最高值之一。稳定功率输出和EQE积分电流（21.35 mA/cm²）与J-V一致。稳定性方面，ISOS-D-2协议（65°C，50% RH，昼夜循环）下，封装器件1000小时后MeO-BADCz保持90.5%初始PCE，优于BABCz（80.1%）和BADBCz（65.3%）。ISOS-L-1（未封装，连续1个太阳光照）下，MeO-BADCz器件1000小时后保持97.1% PCE，显著优于BABCz（90.5%）和BADBCz（85%），挑战了传统认为膦酸锚定优于羧酸锚定的观点。
PL和TRPL显示，MeO-BADCz样品表现出更强的PL淬灭和更短的载流子寿命（τ_ave = 145.77 ns），而BABCz为268.85 ns，BADBCz为331.38 ns，证明空穴提取更高效。TPV和TPC表明，MeO-BADCz器件具有最长的TPV衰减寿命（1.20 ms）和最快的TPC衰减（3.562 μs），表明复合被抑制且提取更快。PLQY测量显示，MeO-BADCz样品的PLQY高达14.1%，准费米能级分裂为1.29 eV，远高于对照，证实界面非辐射复合被有效抑制。DLCP显示MeO-BADCz器件在埋底界面处的陷阱密度最低。Mott-Schottky给出V_bi = 1.226 V（BABCz 1.183 V，BADBCz 1.149 V）。EIS拟合表明MeO-BADCz具有最高的复合电阻（3782 Ω·cm²）和最低的串联电阻（9.4 Ω·cm²），归因于其三维连续电荷传输网络。
要点6：钙钛矿/硅叠层电池性能
采用双面织构化n型硅异质结底电池（金字塔尺寸1.5–2.5 μm），SAM作为复合层和空穴选择层，顶部为1.68 eV宽带隙钙钛矿。BADBCz基叠层PCE为31.04%，BABCz为32.11%，MeO-BADCz最佳：实验室效率33.53%（Voc 1.968 V，Jsc 20.76 mA/cm²，FF 82.07%），经CPVT认证PCE为33.04%（Voc 1.960 V，Jsc 20.66 mA/cm²，FF 81.58%），为当时最高认证效率之一。稳定输出33.32% @ 1.74 V。EQE积分电流分别为20.77和20.78 mA/cm²，匹配良好。SEM显示MeO-BADCz修饰后，钙钛矿在织构化硅上实现垂直无间隙覆盖，而BADBCz存在裸露金字塔和空隙。稳定性方面，ISOS-D-2下500小时后，MeO-BADCz叠层保持85.1%初始PCE（BABCz 75.8%，BADBCz 62.8%）。ISOS-L-1 MPP追踪500小时后，MeO-BADCz保持92.6% PCE，BADBCz仅62.8%。优异的稳定性归因于高质量的钙钛矿结晶和SAM本身的电化学鲁棒性。
本研究通过理性设计一系列立体扩展的不对称咔唑基SAM分子，系统揭示了分子构象、堆积模式与聚集行为、电荷传输能力之间的内在关联。适度聚集有助于形成电荷传输通道，过度聚集导致覆盖不均，而完全松散则破坏传输。MeO-BADCz通过三节段扭曲骨架和甲氧基取代，实现了“抑制过度聚集”与“构建三维C–H···π电荷逾渗网络”的巧妙平衡，同时增强了ITO锚定、功函数调控、缺陷钝化和界面能带弯曲。基于MeO-BADCz的宽带隙PSC实现了24.05%的效率，并在1000小时光照老化后保持97.1%的初始效率；将其应用于织构化硅/钙钛矿叠层电池，获得了33.04%的认证效率，且展现出优异的湿热和光照稳定性。这项工作为设计适应粗糙衬底、兼具高覆盖均匀性和高效电荷传输的下一代SAM材料提供了明确的分子工程准则，对推动钙钛矿/硅叠层光伏的产业化具有重要意义。

entries.t: Fortescue与Nabrawind在非洲部署首台无起重机安装风电机组
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/风电
entries.as: Fortescue旗下Nabrawind在非洲部署了首台无需起重机安装的风力发电机组，突破传统大型吊车难以进入偏远地区的工程瓶颈。无起重机安装技术可降低风电场建设成本、减少复杂地形限制，对非洲清洁能源发展具有示范意义，为偏远地区大型风电项目提供了新方案。
kp: [部署方式]: 无起重机自吊装(Nabrawind TSE)

And, most importantly, Total SES is capable of working with many types of existing wind turbines.
The technology developed by Nabralift has evolved, making it possible to lift any type of tower once the rotor has been installed at a height of 30–40 m (previously 90–100 m). The operation is performed reliably in unstable winds, at speeds of 15 m/s and bursts of up to 20 m/s, unlike conventional cranes that can only operate in winds of up to 6–8 m/s for the installation of certain components, such as the blades. The Innovent Diaz wind farm, located in one of the world’s most wind-rich areas, has enabled the validation of this installation system across the entire range of wind speeds.
In addition, the system allows for the hoisting of sections of thin-walled tubular towers without compromising their structural integrity, thanks to Total SES technology, which builds on Nabralift’s Self-Erecting System (SES) to enable its use on all types of wind towers.
The InnoVent Diaz wind farm will eventaully feature seven Goldwind GW165/6000 wind turbines deployed with Nabrawind’s Total SES and Skylift solutions, enabling the company to demonstrate both the repeatability of the processes and their ability to handle complex installation procedures a broader range of environmental conditions.

entries.t: 中国新型无人机蜂群系统声称可在干扰环境下猎杀目标
entries.c: AI与智能科技/具身智能/模型和具身操作系统
entries.as: 中国研究团队声称开发出一种新型AI算法，使无人机蜂群在强电子干扰环境下仍能协同猎杀目标。传统无人机依赖GPS与无线电链路，易受干扰失效。该系统据称利用视觉与惯性导航、群体自组网及分布式决策算法，在卫星定位与通信中断时自主维持编队与目标锁定。报道强调其抗干扰与去中心化协同能力，但作战效能仍取决于实际部署场景与对抗手段，相关技术细节尚未经独立验证。

entries.b:
A Chinese research team claims to have developed a new artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm capable of allowing drone swarms to autonomously hunt and eliminate targets even when communications are jammed and visibility is severely degraded.
The algorithm, called
Heterogeneous Graph Spatio-Temporal Reasoning
(HG-STR), was detailed in a paper published in China’s leading aviation journal,
Acta Aeronautica et Astronautica Sinica
, earlier this month.
According to the researchers
, it is the first known system capable of achieving a “100 percent kill rate” while operating quickly enough to keep pace with modern combat conditions. However, a word of caution.
As with many military AI claims, the headline figure should be treated carefully. Especially since a perfect kill rate in simulation is very different from real battlefield performance.
Modern warfare introduces weather, deception, civilian presence, damaged sensors, electronic warfare, and countless unpredictable variables that can rapidly degrade even highly advanced systems.
That said, the underlying technology is worth paying attention to because it reflects a broader and very real shift in how militaries are approaching autonomous warfare. After all, most existing drone systems still rely heavily on human operators.
Even advanced swarms often depend on stable communications and relatively simple coordination logic. Lose the radio link or block the drones’ sensors, and effectiveness can collapse quickly. HG-STR is reportedly designed specifically to address that problem.
Traditional battlefield AI systems often treat all incoming information similarly. A drone, a tank, a building, or a hill may simply become another object inside a dataset.
The Chinese researchers argue that this approach struggles to capture the true complexity of combat environments. Their system instead builds a dynamic “graph” of the battlefield, where different entities are treated differently and linked together through relationships.
Seen in this light, a radar installation is not merely an object. It is a threat node connected to terrain, airspace, jamming sources, and defensive positions.
Further, a forest becomes concealment, a hill a line-of-sight blocker. Other things, like friendly drones, become information-sharing assets rather than isolated units.
The result is a swarm
capable of making higher-level tactical inferences rather than simply reacting to what it directly sees.
In practical terms, this could allow drones to continue pursuing targets even when communications are severed or direct visual confirmation is lost. A swarm may infer likely enemy positions from terrain, movement patterns, or previous observations and continue adapting independently.
That capability matters because modern warfare is increasingly dominated by electronic warfare. The conflict in Ukraine has demonstrated how rapidly drones can become blind, jammed, spoofed, or disconnected.
Future autonomous systems will need to function inside exactly those kinds of degraded environments. The most striking part is the suggestion that swarms could eventually be sent into contested battlespaces with only a final human instruction before operating independently.
So, instead of humans directly controlling drones, future operators may increasingly define objectives while AI systems determine execution in real time. And China is far from alone in pursuing these technologies.
The United States, NATO countries, and Russia are all investing heavily in autonomous swarm warfare, collaborative combat aircraft, and AI-assisted battlefield coordination.

entries.c: AI与智能科技/具身智能/硬件和控制
entries.as: 中国邮政据报道已在世界最繁忙的邮政网络之一部署人形机器人用于包裹分拣，每小时可处理约1200件。该人形机器人集成视觉识别、抓取规划与自主导航能力，可在分拣中心执行搬运与分类任务。此举是中国加速推进人形机器人产业化落地的重要示范，验证其在物流仓储等结构化场景的可用性与经济性。业内关注点在于实际作业连续性、故障率以及与现有自动化流水线的协同效率。

entries.b:
China has reportedly deployed humanoid robots into one of the world’s busiest postal networks as the country accelerates efforts to automate logistics at a massive scale.
Images released this week from the
logistics site under the
postal center show humanoid robotic sorters handling parcels alongside robotic arms and unmanned forklifts in a highly automated warehouse environment.
According to
, the robots are capable of processing up to 1,200 parcels per hour as part of a broader modernization push by China Post Group.
The facility, located in
in southern Guangdong Province, can allegedly handle an average of 6.5 million pieces of mail every day, with peak volumes exceeding 10 million.
To be able to deal with those numbers, operators have increasingly turned toward autonomous systems capable of working continuously with minimal human intervention.
While robotic arms and automated conveyor systems are already common in large fulfillment hubs worldwide, the use of humanoid robots represents a notable shift in strategy. Unlike traditional industrial robots, humanoid systems are designed to operate in environments originally built for people.
That means they can theoretically move through existing warehouses, identify parcels, interact with shelves or cages, and adapt to changing tasks without requiring an entirely new facility layout.
Footage released by
shows humanoid robots gripping parcels from containers and placing them onto sorting lines, while autonomous forklifts transport loads through the warehouse floor. The machines appear to work in coordination with conventional automation systems already installed at the site.
Looking at the bigger picture, China has rapidly emerged as one of the leading markets for humanoid robotics development. In response, companies across the country are racing to commercialize systems for manufacturing, logistics, elderly care, and public service applications.
Backed by heavy government investment and a strong domestic robotics supply chain, Chinese firms are increasingly positioning humanoid robots not as experimental showcase machines, but as practical industrial tools.
Logistics, in particular, has become an attractive sector for deployment. Warehouses and postal centers operate around the clock, labor shortages remain a challenge in many regions, and parcel volumes continue to surge due to e-commerce growth.
To this end, robots that can autonomously sort, transport, and identify packages offer the potential to reduce operational costs while improving throughput during peak demand periods.
postal center’s latest deployment also highlights how modern logistics automation is evolving beyond single-purpose machinery.
Instead of relying solely on fixed robotic systems, operators are beginning to integrate multiple autonomous technologies into a connected ecosystem that includes mobile robots, machine vision, AI-driven identification systems, and unmanned vehicles.
However, questions remain over long-term reliability, maintenance costs, and whether humanoid systems can consistently outperform simpler robotic alternatives in real-world logistics environments. Humanoid robots are generally more mechanically complex and expensive than fixed industrial automation.
That said, China’s willingness to deploy the technology at scale suggests the country sees humanoid robotics as more than a futuristic experiment. In facilities processing millions of parcels each day, even small gains in efficiency can translate into significant operational and economic advantages.

entries.as: 光生电荷在微米到纳米尺度上的分离是光电和光催化转化的核心过程。本研究利用时空分辨光谱技术，揭示光学微腔驱动下光生电荷的分离机制，表明微腔与分子间的强耦合可调控电荷转移路径与效率。该发现为设计高效光电和光催化器件提供了新思路。

entries.b: Photogenerated charge separation across micro- to nanometer scales is essential for photoelectric and photocatalytic conversion. However, identifying microstructures that sustain efficient charge separation and elucidating the underlying mechanisms remain challenging. Here, by combining surface photovoltage microscopy with optical imaging, we show that optically resonant cavity structures generate highly nonuniform light-field distributions that subsequently drive efficient charge separation through asymmetric electron and hole diffusivities. Spatiotemporal imaging of carrier dynamics from femtoseconds to seconds reveals that this charge separation originates from the combined contributions of ultrafast hot-electron diffusion (∼3 ps) and long-lived trap-limited transport (∼5 ms). Leveraging these effects, we demonstrate control over both the magnitude and direction of charge separation via optical structure engineering. These findings deepen the fundamental understanding of diffusion-driven charge separation in semiconductors and establish optical-architecture engineering as a viable approach for manipulating it, providing a blueprint for advancing solar energy conversion and optoelectronic technologies.

entries.t: 电荷密度波交织超导体中的超流效应
entries.c: 通用技术/材料工程/其它先进材料
entries.as: 研究在电荷密度波（CDW）交织的超导体中观测到超流效应。准粒子的能量-动量色散是凝聚态物理中的基础概念，而电荷密度波与超导序的共存与竞争近年来备受关注。该工作通过实验揭示超导电流对CDW调制的影响，表明两种量子有序态之间存在深度交织耦合，为理解非常规超导机制、探索拓扑物态及设计新型量子器件提供了关键实验依据。

entries.b: The energy-momentum (E-k) dispersion of quasiparticles constitutes a fundamental concept in condensed matter systems. The ability to modify the E-k dispersion, exemplified by supercurrent-induced Doppler shifts of Bogoliubov quasiparticle spectra in superconductors, enables manipulation of various emergent quantum properties. However, investigations into the supercurrent effect on superconductors intertwined with charge orders remain scarce. Here, we report that the Meissner current, generated by the diamagnetic response to an applied in-plane magnetic field, can tailor Bogoliubov quasiparticle excitations at the precursor charge density wave (CDW) vectors. Our scanning tunneling spectroscopic imaging reveals a field-driven symmetry breaking of CDW modulations, specifically a C3v-to-Cs transition, in superconducting NbSe2. Model calculations suggest that the observed anisotropy originates from a selective Doppler-shift-induced E-k dispersion reconstruction. Furthermore, altering the field direction enables on-demand tuning of anisotropic CDW modulations and visualization of their momentum-space distribution. These results highlight a novel mechanism for controlling emergent electronic phases through momentum-space engineering.
